findings.claim: Storm Lure guarantees that every Legendary fish triggers a Storm Leviathan encounter
findings.correct_value: Lure adds an additive bonus to the base encounter chance (src/fishing/generation.rs:242-244 encounter_chance = LEVIATHAN_ENCOUNTER_CHANCES[..] + lure_encounter_bonus); starts at +0, +0.5%/missed legendary capped +10%, +1.5% permanent tracking per completed encounter; persists until an encounter fires. Dev doc src/fishing/CLAUDE.md makes the same 'guarantees' claim as the old wiki - possible code-vs-intent bug flagged to the team

findings.claim: If the encounter is missed, the lure builds up a small tracking bonus that persists across lure uses
findings.correct_value: Misses build lure_miss_ramp (+0.5%, cap 10%, resets on encounter); the permanent lure_tracking_bonus (+1.5%) accrues per completed encounter (src/fishing/logic.rs:143-181)
